items.title: Walter "Furry" Lewis Interview, 1967-05-03
items.q: Well we was in New York together.

ctx.x: Well I hope he will then we can have a little music or something. Yeah. Because I haven't. You see it's like I tell you. I do some money to come in but it's have never started yet. You know how it is when you just. Yeah. Well I know. Ain't got no kind of income like that. It's pretty tough.
And you know Sleepy John asked each what happened to him?
Well we was in New York together. Mmhmm. I heard he moved to Memphis. I don't know why he asked.
